items.title: How fast does fighting everything burn your credibility?
items.description: Simple teaching model, not a measured curve: represents how much credibility you have left for a genuinely important battle, as a function of how many low-stakes battles you fight per month. It drops fast — even a couple of unnecessary fights a month leaves you with noticeably less standing for the one that actually matters, which is L1 and L2's point about fighting everything making people stop taking your objections seriously.
items.compute: const credibility = Math.round(100 * Math.exp(-params.battlesPerMonth * 0.35)); return { credibility };

outputs.label: Credibility remaining for a battle that actually matters

items.title: How far does slow drift travel, and how fast?
items.description: Simple teaching model, not a measured curve: represents distance from your original values as a function of months of accumulated small, individually-defensible compromises. It starts slow — early compromises barely register — then accelerates, because each one makes the next slightly easier to wave through, which is exactly L2's identity-drift mechanism. The default sits at 14 months, the point in L1's scenario where the pattern first becomes visible to the engineer looking back at it.
items.compute: const driftDistance = Math.round(100 * Math.pow(params.monthsOfSmallCompromises / 24, 1.6)); return { driftDistance };
